<tree string="Next Activities" decoration-danger="sh_date_deadline < current_date and state != 'done'" decoration-success="sh_date_deadline == current_date and state != 'done'" default_order="date_deadline" create="1" decoration-muted="state == 'done'" multi_edit="1">
                <field name="res_name" modifiers="{"readonly": true}"/>
                <field name="activity_type_id" on_change="1" can_create="true" can_write="true"/>
            <field name="user_id" widget="many2one_avatar_user" on_change="1" modifiers="{"required": true}" can_create="true" can_write="true"/>
                <field name="summary" on_change="1"/>
                <field name="date_deadline" widget="remaining_days" options="{'allow_order': '1'}" on_change="1" modifiers="{"required": true, "column_invisible": true}"/>
                <field name="sh_date_deadline" options="{'allow_order': '1'}" string="Due Date" on_change="1" modifiers="{"required": true}"/>
                <field name="due_in_text" string="Due In" modifiers="{"readonly": true}"/>
                <field name="domain_sale_team_ids" modifiers="{"readonly": true, "column_invisible": true}"/>
                <field name="sale_team_id" string="Sale Team" optional="show" on_change="1" can_create="true" can_write="true"/>
                <field name="crm_department_id" string="Department" optional="show" can_create="true" can_write="true"/>
                <field name="state" on_change="1" modifiers="{"readonly": true, "column_invisible": true}"/>
                <field name="sh_state" decoration-success="sh_state == 'done'" decoration-warning="state == 'today' or state == 'planned'" decoration-danger="state == 'cancelled' or state == 'overdue'" widget="badge" string="State"/>
                <field name="date_done" widget="remaining_days" options="{'allow_order': '1'}" modifiers="{"readonly": true}"/>
                <field name="sh_activity_tags" widget="many2many_tags" options="{'color_field': 'color', 'no_create_edit': True}" can_create="true" can_write="true"/>
                <field name="feedback" modifiers="{"invisible": [["state", "!=", "done"]]}"/>
                <field name="company_id" optional="hide" can_create="true" can_write="true"/>
                <field name="create_date" optional="hide" modifiers="{"readonly": true}"/>
                <field name="write_date" optional="hide" modifiers="{"readonly": true}"/>
                <field name="date_done" optional="hide" widget="remaining_days" options="{'allow_order': '1'}" modifiers="{"readonly": true}"/>
                <field name="display_name" optional="hide" modifiers="{"readonly": true}"/>
                <field name="previous_activity_type_id" optional="hide" on_change="1" modifiers="{"readonly": true}"/>
                <field name="res_id" optional="hide" on_change="1"/>
                <field name="res_model" optional="hide" on_change="1" modifiers="{"readonly": true}"/>
                <field name="res_model_id" optional="hide" on_change="1" modifiers="{"required": true}" can_create="true" can_write="true"/>
                <field name="supervisor_ids" optional="hide" widget="many2many_avatar_user" can_create="true" can_write="true"/>
                <field name="sh_user_ids" optional="hide" can_create="true" can_write="true"/>
                <field name="active" modifiers="{"column_invisible": true}"/>
                <field name="activity_cancel" modifiers="{"column_invisible": true}"/>
               <field name="activity_done" modifiers="{"column_invisible": true}"/>
            <button type="object" string="Edit" name="action_edit_activity" class="btn btn-primary" icon="fa-pencil" modifiers="{"invisible": [["active", "=", false]]}"/>
            <button type="object" string="Origin" name="action_view_activity" class="btn btn-primary" icon="fa-history"/>
            </tree>

search.arch:
<search string="Activity">
            <field name="res_name" string="Activity" filter_domain="['|','|','|','|','|','|','|',('res_name', 'ilike', self),('activity_type_id','ilike',self),('user_id','ilike',self),('res_model','ilike',self),('res_model_id','ilike',self),('supervisor_ids','ilike',self),('sh_activity_tags','ilike',self),('sh_user_ids','ilike',self)]"/>
                <field name="supervisor_ids"/>
                <field name="sh_activity_tags"/>
                <filter string="Completed Activities" name="activities_completed" domain="[('state', '=', 'done'),('active','=',False)]"/>
            <filter string="Cancelled Activities" name="activities_cancelled" domain="[('state', '=', 'cancel'),('active','=',False)]"/>
                <filter string="Archived Activities" name="archived_activities" domain="[('active','=',False)]"/>
                <filter string="Activity Tags" name="activity_tags" domain="[('sh_activity_tags','!=',False)]"/>
                <field name="res_model"/>
                <field name="summary"/>
                <field name="activity_type_id"/>
                <filter string="Late Activities" name="activities_overdue" domain="[('date_deadline', '<', context_today().strftime('%Y-%m-%d'))]" help="Show all records which has next action date is before today" modifiers="{"invisible": true}"/>
                <filter string="Today Activities" name="activities_today" domain="[('date_deadline', '=', context_today().strftime('%Y-%m-%d'))]" modifiers="{"invisible": true}"/>
                <filter string="Future Activities" name="activities_upcoming_all" domain="[('date_deadline', '>', context_today().strftime('%Y-%m-%d'))                         ]" modifiers="{"invisible": true}"/>
                <group expand="0" string="Group By">
                    <filter string="Deadline" name="date_deadline" context="{'group_by': 'date_deadline'}"/>
                    <filter string="Created By" name="createdby" context="{'group_by': 'create_uid'}"/>
                    <filter string="Activity Type" name="activittype" context="{'group_by': 'activity_type_id'}"/>
                <filter string="Assign To" name="assign_to" context="{'group_by':'user_id'}"/>
                <filter string="Supervisors" name="supervisors" context="{'group_by':'supervisor_ids'}"/>
                <filter string="Document Model" name="document_model" context="{'group_by':'res_model_id'}"/>
                <filter string="Tags" name="tags" context="{'group_by':'sh_activity_tags'}"/>
                <filter string="Assigned Multi Users" name="users" context="{'group_by':'sh_user_ids'}"/>
                </group>
            <searchpanel>
            <field name="company_id" icon="fa-building" enable_counters="1"/>
            <field name="activity_type_id" icon="fa-tasks" enable_counters="1"/>
            <field name="user_id" limit="20" hierarchize="0" select="one" icon="fa-users" enable_counters="1"/>
            <field name="res_model_id" enable_counters="1"/>
            <field name="sh_state" enable_counters="1" string="State"/>
            </searchpanel>
            </search>
